review.method: Independent visual review of Poppler-rendered source pages, cross-checked with pdftotext -layout and the authored schedule row labels.
review.reason: The frozen compile keys predate coverage of visibly authored air-device and expansion-tank schedule rows. These additive corrections preserve the original files and change only independently reviewed omissions.

evidence: GRILLE, REGISTER, AND DIFFUSER SCHEDULE has 23 authored rows: 12 supply, 8 return, and 3 exhaust devices.
EXPANSION TANK SCHEDULE has two authored equipment rows, ET-1 and ET-2.
DIFFUSER SCHEDULE has seven authored rows, D-1 through D-7.
RETURN & EXHAUST GRILLE SCHEDULE has four authored rows, R-1 through R-4.
